title: Jaws
facts: Steven Spielberg directed Jaws while he was still in his twenties.
The film is based on Peter Benchley's 1974 novel of the same name.
Author Peter Benchley appears on screen as a television reporter on the beach.
The crew nicknamed the mechanical shark "Bruce", after Spielberg's lawyer, Bruce Ramer.
Jaws was filmed on Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts.
John Williams won the Academy Award for his score.
Jaws won three Academy Awards: Film Editing, Original Score, and Sound. It was also nominated for Best Picture.
Roy Scheider's line "You're gonna need a bigger boat" was not in the script.
Quint's boat is named the Orca.
The story takes place on the fictional Amity Island.
Jaws became the highest-grossing film of its time. Star Wars passed it in 1977.
Editor Verna Fields won an Academy Award for her work on the film.
Jaws opened in the United States on June 20, 1975.
The shark is not seen clearly until more than an hour into the film.
In 2001 the Library of Congress selected Jaws for the National Film Registry.
Robert Shaw plays the shark hunter Quint. Richard Dreyfuss plays oceanographer Matt Hooper.
The mechanical sharks often broke down in salt water, so Spielberg showed the shark less and suggested it more.
